$comment: Content-level privacy pre-validation for LONGVIEW (privacy_gate.mjs). Case-insensitive regex tested against each session's CARD fields + raw EVIDENCE text. 'eject' = high-precision personal/CV/job-seeking/PII markers → the session is quarantined before the model/graph phase (nothing personal reaches Neo4j, the vectors, the SAD or the book). 'review' = weaker signals → reported as warnings, never auto-ejected (avoids false positives on legitimate technical content that mentions 'cv'/'salary' in passing). Tune here — no code change; re-run the gate.
$note_resume: Do NOT add a bare 'resume' pattern — this technical corpus is saturated with 'resume-safe'/'resume the run'. The CV document only matches reliably when ACCENTED (résumé) or via 'curriculum vitae'/'my cv'/'cover letter'/cv-path. American un-accented 'resume' is indistinguishable from the verb, so it is intentionally NOT an eject signal.
